messages:
aj_releases: heads up — deploy-bot blocked rc-2.4.0 canary: SBOM provenance missing for a transitive lib. need quick path: pin, regional carveout, hotpatch, or delay. tagging @maria_dev @noah_sre @lisa_legal

deploy-bot: ``
release: rc-2.4.0
component: libfastreq@1.2.3 (transitive)
flag: SBOM_PROVENANCE_MISSING
scan: CVE-2026-12345 (severity: LOW, cvss:3.3)
action: BLOCK_CANARY
```

maria_dev: provenance missing + finance telemetry = legal sensitivity. low severity but unsigned artifacts are a compliance risk. where introduced?
aj_releases: analytics-service -> http-client -> libfastreq, only on new telemetry path. no known exploit reports. scanner requires cosign signature.

noah_sre: ops can do EU-only canary carveout, but that adds routing and capacity caveats. prefer pin to a signed digest for short-term.
lisa_legal: agree with pining; legal wants a ticket for provenance verification and an exception record if we proceed.
tom_qe: confirm whether telemetry path runs in our staged test harness. if not, we'll run full regression during canary after pin.

maria_dev: proposed plan: 1) pin libfastreq to a vetted digest for canary scope 2) run 2h EU-only canary with QE regression and smoke every 15m 3) open security/sbom-provenance + legal-review tickets 4) schedule hotpatch in next change window to replace transitive dep with signed artifact.

noah_sre: plan ack. CLI preview:
```
releasesctl pin --pkg libfastreq@sha256:0a1b2c3d --scope canary:rc-2.4.0
deploybot canary --id rc-2.4.0 --regions eu --duration 2h --note "pin: SBOM provenance missing"
```
aj_releases: I'll add a release note snippet: "EU canary scoped due to SBOM provenance verification pending; full rollout contingent on signed artifact or hotpatch." will notify enterprise contacts.
lisa_legal: OK provided the tickets are created and we escalate if any finance customer raises concerns.
tom_qe: I'll attach regression jobs and monitor canary metrics. will report after first 30m.
maria_dev: preparing pin PR and ticket references now. tagging aj_releases when ready. :white_check_mark:
aj_releases: executing pin + canary; will update thread with metric snapshot. :rocket:
